capabilities: Render .html and .htm files in a sandboxed iframe
Toggle JavaScript execution between safe and interactive modes
Strip script tags, event handlers, and javascript: URLs in safe mode
Switch between raw source and rendered view
Auto-refresh the view when the file is edited externally
disambiguation: Not an HTML editor; it only renders existing .html files and can toggle between raw source and rendered view.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents its security model, blocked capabilities, localStorage session-only limitation, and a version history.
problem: Obsidian does not render local .html files, so HTML documents, visualizations, and games stored in a vault cannot be viewed in-app.
summary: HTML file viewer that renders .html files in a sandboxed iframe inside Obsidian, with a scripts toggle for interactive content.
